asOf: The DAO has not yet formed. A Transition Council has been elected to establish it and carry it through the transition; the standing Council that succeeds them has not been elected, and no permanent seat below has been filled.

transitionCouncil.name: Transition Radix Accountability Council
transitionCouncil.note: Elected with a defined mandate: establish the DAO and carry it through the transition. Its seats end when the Permanent Council is seated. Reach any member directly on Telegram.
transitionCouncil.standingNote: Three of the five are also Members of Radix DAO LLC itself, which is member-managed at formation. That is a legal standing in the company, separate from holding a Council seat, and it is marked below.
transitionCouncil.termNote: Until the Permanent Council is seated

delegatedFunctions.name: Treasury Signers
delegatedFunctions.note: Exactly 5. Ordinarily allocated among seated Council members; a seat may instead be filled by election.
